champion.tips: KAYN TIPS AND TRICKS Skirmish as much as you can with the enemy laner. This will allow you to get your transformation much quicker- even if it’s not the transformation you want. You’ll want to transform into Blue Kayn if the enemy has lots of squishy champions. If they have lots of tanky champs, opt for Red Kayn. Try to avoid using your E often in lane. It costs a lot of mana and has a long cooldown. If you run out of mana or get caught while it’s on cooldown- you’re going to be an easy target for the enemy Jungler.
champion.builds: THE BEST KAYN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kayn Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Axiom Arcanist and Transcendence in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Black Cleaver. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and finish with Spirit Visage. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 46.7% winrate over 861 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kayn Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Spear of Shojin, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Black Cleaver as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Spirit Visage and Overlord's Bloodmail. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 46.0% win rate over 298 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Transcendence in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Black Cleaver as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Spear of Shojin as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Overlord's Bloodmail and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 48.9% win rate across 229 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Kayn Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Transcendence as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Voltaic Cyclosword as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Spear of Shojin as third item. The last 3 options are Serylda's Grudge, Death's Dance and Eclipse. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.8% win rate over 195 matches played. Situational Kayn Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kayn build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kayn runes page.
